title: Devils Tower National Monument
geometryBasis: Devils Tower / Bear Lodge and its bare-rock apron, with the nearby historic ponderosa-log Visitor Center and its short mapped concrete approach.
sectionBasis: The USGS elevation raster provides eleven measured rock contours and fine summit/apron relief. The named OpenStreetMap rock perimeter bounds the model terrain. The visitor-center footprint and same-side paved approach set its north–south ridge and east frontage.

visitorCenter.mainDoorFaces: east toward the mapped concrete approach

limitations: USGS 3DEP determines the plan contour, summit relief and height. Individual column facets, ledge breaks, weathered colors and loose rocks are photographic or geological estimates.
The bare-rock perimeter bounds the terrain opening. The model reproduces the original elevation apron inside that perimeter and retains the original unmasked terrain field for comparison.
The original mapped Visitor Center footprint and east approach are retained. Chimneys, log diameters, foundation contact and unseen elevations are estimated.
